after_snippet:
from PIL import Image
import io

# In 12.2.0, encoding an empty image raises ValueError
img = Image.new('RGB', (0, 0))
buf = io.BytesIO()
try:
    img.save(buf, format='PNG')
except ValueError:
    pass  # Expected in 12.2.0
before_snippet:
from PIL import Image
import io

# In 12.1.1, encoding an empty (zero-dimension) image raises something other than ValueError
# We verify it does NOT raise ValueError (i.e. old behavior)
img = Image.new('RGB', (0, 0))
buf = io.BytesIO()
try:
    img.save(buf, format='PNG')
except ValueError:
    # If ValueError is raised in old version, test fails (we expect old error type)
    raise AssertionError('Got ValueError in old version - unexpected')
except Exception:
    pass  # Expected: some other error in 12.1.1
title: Encoding an empty image now raises ValueError instead of a different error
